name: Laundromat
desc: Waiting in public at an odd hour, with strangers forced to share the time.
tags: laundromat, bank of front loading washing machines, stacked dryers, row of plastic chairs, long folding table, coin slots, detergent boxes on a shelf, wire laundry cart, linoleum floor, fluorescent ceiling light, notice board, plate glass window onto the street
prose: a laundromat with banks of front loading washers facing a row of plastic chairs, a long folding table down the middle and the street dark beyond the plate glass under flat fluorescent light
note: The wall of round glass doors IS the image - say bank of front loading machines, because washing machine on its own gives a domestic utility room with one appliance in it. For the night version the window has to be doing something: name a streetlight or a lit sign outside and grade with sodium or neon. Tagging night here changes nothing, as measured everywhere else.
